headline: 本週英倫影劇書評摘要
context: 英國影劇圈這週很忙：Hannah Waddingham主演的喜劇《Ride Or Die》讓她一人分飾殺手與會計師兩種身分，備受好評；克里斯多福·諾蘭（Christopher Nolan）新作《The Odyssey》被讚為近年最具野心的史詩之作。劇場方面，Soho劇院的音樂產業題材新戲《Hit Machine》評價則普遍不理想。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This tale of a 50-year-old assassin going rogue – and having to confess all to her best mate – is so much fun. The chemistry between its leads is a thing of beauty The bone-deep magnificence of Hannah Waddingham is such that she could, I suspect, talk most of us into a burning car should she wish to. So selling viewers on the delightfully ludicrous premise of the comedy caper Ride Or Die is but the work of a moment. Waddingham plays Whiptail, a deadly assassin for the last 20-odd years whose work has recently become more attention-grabbing than her bosses like. Octavia Spencer (who occupies god-tier comedy status in my heart for her tiny part as Tracy Morgan’s nemesis in 30 Rock alone) is her best friend Debbie. Debbie knows Whiptail as Judith, a forensic accountant, and has no idea that behind the woman she depends on for laughs, emotional support and notes on the latest book club book she hasn’t read is a trained killer. Debbie is married to David (Jamie Parker), a politician, and is the gentle power behind his throne. His personal and professional life have been shaped and smoothed by her for the past 25 years, and he is now on course to be the next prime minister. Continue reading...
sources.title: Ride Or Die review – Hannah Waddingham’s comedy caper is the perimenopausal TV of your dreams

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: No film-maker shows more day-drinking than Hong, and this study of an actor returning from a career break is the same again – as mysteriously addictive as ever It will not surprise fans of the prolific lo-fi Korean master Hong Sang-soo that his new film in black-and-white – which might be described as “experimental” by those who don’t quite realise that they all look like this – features long scenes, shot from a single, static camera position, featuring a conversation in a restaurant. Nor will they be surprised that one of these scenes contains a sudden, unobtrusive zoom-in to a closer position, for no obvious reason. It will not be startling for them that the film features someone playing a female screen star of a certain age philosophically pondering her career and life-choices (a key Hong trope). And it certainly won’t be a shock that the film has a character ordering a beer or two before the sun is technically over the yardarm. There is no one in the movies, or in any of the arts, or any aspect of public life, anywhere in the world, who is more utterly dedicated to day-drinking than Hong Sang-soo. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Day She Returns review – another Hong Sang-soo round of slow, reflective boozing really hits the spot

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Five decades since punk bible Sniffin’ Glue, DIY magazines are in rude, rich health. Their creators talk fandom, community-building and resisting the algorithm ‘The most important part of the word ‘fanzine’ is ‘fan’,” says London-based zine-maker Jon Marsh. Existing outside mainstream media, free from the demands of release cycles and search engine optimisation, music fanzines are obsessions turned into tangible objects; self-published primarily for the maker’s own enjoyment, but with the potential of forging connections with like-minded people. In the 1970s, punk zines such as Sniffin’ Glue, Alternative Ulster and Ripped & Torn allowed fans to share news and enthusiasm quickly and cheaply. Half a century on, music fanzines are enjoying a resurgence as a form of resistance to algorithm fatigue and the hyper-capitalist music industry. “Digital attention span is at an all-time low,” says hip-hop musician ExP, creator of the West Yorkshire Hip-Hop zine. “You’re almost definitely going to spend more time looking at a zine than anything you see scrolling. It’s more interesting and more real.” In the words of Stephen McRobbie, from indie-pop icons and fanzine regulars the Pastels: “It’s the long way round compared to other media, but the scenery is always better.” Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘More real than anything you’ll see scrolling’: the radical resurgence of UK fanzines, 50 years after punk

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Soho theatre, London Josh Radnor is a music executive whose life is upended by his wayward brother, in a play about masculinity, creativity, appropriation and trauma On paper, writer Jonathan Caren’s Hit Machine has all the makings of a chart-topping smash. Featuring the London stage debuts of Josh Radnor (How I Met Your Mother) and Noah Galvin (Dear Evan Hansen), with direction from Daniel Bailey ( Red Pitch ) and music by Grammy-winning bluesman Ben Harper, the three-hander tackles the topics of masculinity, appropriation and buried family trauma through the prism of the creative process. Set in the louche, soft-furnished home of music mogul Wes (Radnor), the play begins promisingly. Wayward younger brother Alex (Galvin) arrives and throws a plaid-shirted bomb into Wes’s carefully manicured and minimalist life. We begin to see how each sibling plays their role in the strained family dynamic: Wes the high-achiever on the hedonic treadmill always striving for more, and Alex the sprightly yet secretive youngster striving only for approval. At Soho theatre, London , until 15 August Continue reading...
sources.title: Hit Machine review – slick music biz drama strikes too many false notes

thread_text:
英國影劇圈這幾天很熱鬧。Hannah Waddingham主演的喜劇《Ride Or Die》講一位當了二十年殺手的女子，如何瞞著死黨假扮成會計師，兩人的化學反應被讚爆笑又有溫度。南韓導演洪常秀（Hong Sang-soo）的新片《The Day She Returns》延續他一貫的黑白長鏡頭美學，講一位女演員回歸演藝圈後的反思，被形容「莫名讓人上癮」。書市這邊，Avni Doshi的新作《The First House》被評為對婚姻與自由的深刻描寫，另一本《Hidden Creatures》則帶讀者認識寄生蟲的世界。動畫改編方面，Andy Serkis執導的《動物農莊》被批評把歐威爾的諷刺經典包裝得過於溫吞討喜；反倒是《華萊士與阿高》的雙集合輯，被誇是完美的組合。劇場這邊，Simon Stone重新編排的《奧瑞斯提亞》三部曲評價褒貶參半，Soho劇院的音樂產業新戲《Hit Machine》則被認為彈得不太準。音樂方面，英國的DIY樂迷雜誌文化正在復興，五十年前龐克時代《Sniffin' Glue》的精神，如今在對抗演算法疲勞的年輕世代身上重新發芽；BBC逍遙音樂節（Proms）今年的節目單也已經出爐。最後，諾蘭的新作《The Odyssey》被形容為近年最具野心的史詩電影之一，「每一格畫面都充滿熱情」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 15、16 日的報導。

voice_text: 英國影劇圈這幾天有點忙。喜劇《Ride Or Die》裡，女主角白天假扮會計師，晚上其實是幹了二十年的殺手，這個反差讓故事笑點十足。南韓導演洪常秀的新片，一如既往用黑白長鏡頭，講一位女演員重返演藝圈的心境，步調慢，卻讓人捨不得轉台。書市這邊也有兩本新書，一本寫婚姻裡的自由與拉扯，另一本則帶你認識寄生蟲的世界——聽起來嚇人，寫得倒挺迷人。動畫改編的《動物農莊》，把歐威爾的諷刺經典包得太甜，反而失了諷刺的力道；同期上的《華萊士與阿高》雙集合輯，倒是評價亮眼。劇場這邊，重新編排的《奧瑞斯提亞》三部曲評價兩極，講音樂產業的新戲則被說彈得不太準。克里斯多福·諾蘭的新片《The Odyssey》，被讚是近年最有野心的史詩電影，畫面熱血又講究。最後，英國的手工樂迷雜誌文化正在復興，五十年前龐克時代那股精神，這幾年反倒成了年輕人對抗演算法疲勞的方式。
